bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'DEBUGAI_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DEBUGAI_CLEAN='; if test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
for name in debug-ai-debug-ai-1 debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1; do
  if docker inspect "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf '%s=' "$name"
    docker inspect "$name" --format '{{.State.Running}} {{.Image}}'
  else
    printf '%s=UNAVAILABLE\n' "$name"
  fi
done
if docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -E '^DEBUG_AI_(ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE|CORE_GATE_DISPATCH_MODE)=' || true
fi
printf 'HTTP_HEALTH='
curl --silent --show-error --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8787/health || true
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/".config/debugai-gitops/delegations/policies/dlg_master_debugai_v1.json"
try:
    policy=json.loads(p.read_text())
    print("POLICY_ENABLED="+str(policy.get("enabled") is True))
    print("POLICY_REVOKED="+str(policy.get("revoked") is True))
    for op in ("deploy","host.command","reflect"):
        print("POLICY_OPERATION_"+op+"="+str(op in policy.get("allowed_operations",[])))
    print("POLICY_PR115_BRANCH="+str("fix/debugai-scout-diagnosis-handoff-20261016" in policy.get("allowed_branches",[])))
except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError):
    print("POLICY_READBACK=UNAVAILABLE")
PY
